# lab speed

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
Speed test any OpenAI-compatible server the same way (llama.cpp, Strata, ...): fixed prompts, medians of 3.
  short: code prompt (~40 tokens in), 400 out, temp 0: writing tok/s (best case for MTP)
  long:  ~32K-token prompt (Python standard library source), 32 out: reading tok/s = prompt / time to first token
  lab speed coder "baseline"                                    zaphod's llama-swap (ZAPHOD_KEY)
  MACHINE=marvin BASE_URL=http://marvin:8099/v1 API_KEY=... lab speed <model> "<note>"   (MACHINE: who served it)
Writes tuning/runs/<date>-speed-<model>.json and logs speed_* to MLflow (NOLOG=1 skips logging).
Good result: three short and three long lines, then "median: writing N tok/s; 32K reading N tok/s" and "Logged run".
```

Usage:

```
lab speed <model> <note>
```
